$comment: Exact points rules (client values). Allocation details and the two attempt adjustments below are policy choices: the shipped defaults keep the client's formula (adjustments OFF). A named person changes them only by saving a confirmed version in Administration -> Points policy (points_policy_versions); every evaluation and ledger row records the policy version it used.

PTS-NR3.eligibility: WO route-complete for required good qty; no rework of any type, no scrap, no FAIL holds, no downstream defects on any tank of the WO

PTS-OF2.eligibility: defect caught and authorised correction completed at its origin station; first-stage scrap never qualifies; no downstream defect

PTS-DD4.eligibility: only against confirmed responsible worker/crew after a named reviewer confirms; pending investigations produce no deduction; equipment/material/supplier/process causes produce none

allocation.wo_award: proportional to recorded eligible contribution minutes on the WO; no valid denominator -> PENDING
allocation.time_points: crew share = worker eligible minutes / crew eligible minutes on the attempt; the attempt allowance is split, never duplicated
allocation.crew_deduction: confirmed responsibility shares (sum 1); default equal shares among confirmed responsible crew
allocation.residual: largest remainder, ties by WORKER_ID ascending, so allocations sum exactly

eligibility.rework_time: rework attempts earn time points only against an APPROVED rework standard (rework_standards: named approver, version, effective date); a planning value is never treated as approved - without one the attempt stays PENDING
eligibility.inspection_time: inspection attempts are not time-scored (no inspector speed incentive)

attempt_adjustments.$comment: Exceptions beyond the client's TV1 formula. OFF by default; switching one on requires a confirmed policy version (confirmation statement + named confirmer).
